disclaimer: ⚠️ All apps in this store are experimental and in active development, provided AS IS with no warranty. They interact with a live blockchain and real funds — back up your seed, test with small amounts, and use entirely at your own risk. Not financial advice.

apps.name: PandaApps
apps.description: This store — install and update native Minima apps (SHA-256 verified). Falls back to IPFS if GitHub is unreachable, so it keeps working. Official-app UPDATES download to your Downloads to install manually; first-time installs go direct.

apps.name: Terminal IDE
apps.description: Professional developer tooling for the Minima protocol — a full node terminal with tab-driven autocomplete and offline help for every command, a KISS VM smart-contract editor (lint, offline test in the node's own VM, deploy) and a guided transaction workbench. 0.2.0: completion redesign — the suggestion pills are replaced by an IDE-style dropdown showing only the chosen command's parameters and values, each with its description from the node help; Tab (hardware or on-screen ⇥) accepts and chains command → param → value. Works with any Minima Core; large command outputs (>256KB) and megammrsync-style commands need the Minima Core New UI (Preview) 1.3.0+ node.

apps.name: Zero Edge Casino
apps.description: Provably-fair on-chain casino — coin flip, dice and roulette via a 3-phase commit-reveal contract. Zero house edge. v0.6.3: fixed the coin animation showing the wrong face (Tails was drawn as Heads — display only, results were always correct); roulette wheel is now a true no-zero 36-pocket wheel in the authentic clustered order.

apps.name: Filez
apps.description: Native file manager for your node's base folder. Export backups, archive exports and .txn files to your phone, and import documents into the node for restore / archive import / txnimport. Needs Minima Core 1.3.1+ (New UI preview) and the Admin toggle in Minima Core → Apps.

apps.name: Minima Vestr
apps.description: Token-vesting contract manager — create and track scheduled token releases on Minima.

apps.name: FutureCash
apps.description: Send Minima or tokens to the future — lock funds until a block you choose; the recipient collects when it matures. Interoperable with the FutureCash MiniDapp.

apps.name: Minima Limit
apps.description: On-chain limit-order DEX for MINIMA/USDT — place buy & sell orders at your price; trustless full-fill swaps via a VERIFYOUT smart contract. Good-till-cancelled orders auto-renew so they never expire. Shares the same order book as the Limit MiniDapp.

apps.name: AtomiX
apps.description: minimaSwap + usdtSwap combined into ONE app — pick your currency from the header pill and swap either native MINIMA ↔ ERC20, or bridged native-USDT (mxUSDT) ↔ ERC20 USDT. Trustless HTLC atomic swaps, no custodian. You publish and market-make in ONE currency at a time, and switching currency re-themes the whole app to that identity (Minima orange ↔ Tether green) and moves your market to that book — the legacy per-currency order books, so AtomiX interoperates with existing minimaSwap / usdtSwap peers. Background settlement is currency-agnostic: switching currency NEVER strands an in-flight swap in the other one. Carries the full feature set (depth-ladder market-making, best-price market-sweep taking, OTC tab, embedded ETH wallet, both directions, background watcher) plus the claim-path reliability hardening. v0.1.13: the Wallet tab's red Ethereum-RPC warning now clears itself. It was only ever set, never cleared, so ONE transient RPC or DNS blip pinned the message on screen until you restarted the app — even while balances underneath it kept updating normally. It now disappears on the next good read. v0.1.11: fund-safety — a harvested HTLC preimage is now verified to hash to the lock before it is trusted, so a forged on-chain reveal (the notify sink is anyone-can-write) can no longer poison the secret store and block your claim. v0.1.9: the Wallet tab gains Send — move ETH or USDT out to any address, with balance and gas checks, a Max button and a review step. v0.1.8: settlement hardening — a claim now verifies the received coin is the right token before completing, a mismatched counterparty lock can no longer hold up a valid claim, and the responder’s timing guard reads Ethereum chain time. v0.1.7: when several makers quote the same best price, a swap now fills the DEEPEST maker first — so a fillable amount uses one swap instead of splitting into extra legs (a strictly better price still always wins). v0.1.6: the live order book refreshes every ~90s and re-checks the maker at take time, so a market a maker has WITHDRAWN can no longer show as tradeable. v0.1.5: switching currency TOMBSTONES your live market on the old book and REMEMBERS each currency's market. v0.1.3: ladder defaults to a SINGLE level (multi-leg opt-in, up to 6) and the AtomiX atom icon. EXPERIMENTAL; test small.

apps.name: Minima Core
apps.description: Run a full Minima Core node on Android — the node the companion apps connect to. (If you already run a node, you may already have this installed.)

apps.name: Minima Core — New UI (Preview)
apps.description: Minima Core with eurobuddha's brand-native dark-first UI restyle, H2 fix, large-response IPC, file bridge, startup params, Logs tab and streaming MegaMMR import. 1.6.1: the import aborts with a clean error before memory runs out (no more crashes), and with -megaprune in Startup Params extra args prunable coins never enter RAM - the recommended way to run mainnet MegaMMR on a phone. Installs manually over the official build (back up your seed first).

apps.name: Minima Terminal

apps.name: Minima Wallet
apps.description: Self-custodial Minima wallet — signs locally, uses Minima Core only as a NON-admin relay (works with node admin OFF). PRE-VERIFICATION TEST BUILD: viewing balances + receiving is safe; do NOT send real funds until on-device verification confirms a transaction lands on-chain. Coins received are always recoverable from your seed. When importing a seed, enter how many signatures it has already used (over-estimate if unsure) — this protects against reusing a one-time key.

apps.name: FreezePeach
apps.description: Censorship-resistant, self-custodial chat on the MaxLite off-chain network. Your identity is your Minima seed — the same on any device — end-to-end sealed, no phone number, no account, no server that can read or block you. Premium two-theme design, scan/paste contacts, short IDs, group chats with media + admins, rich sealed photos/video, and a full photo editor: filters, adjust, crop, rotate, markup, plus a native retro-effects studio (filtr, ported to OpenGL ES): dithering & palettes, halftone, edge-detect, ASCII art, CRT, scanlines, RGB-split, bloom, grain. Now includes a full non-custodial in-app Minima wallet: local WOTS signing (seed never leaves the device), send to any address or straight to a contact from the chat with a payment bubble, token icons + names + web-validation checkmarks, and a live balance.

apps.name: PandaPools
apps.description: Constant-product AMM liquidity pools on Minima — swap MINIMA/token across aggregated micro-pools, provide liquidity and earn the 0.5% swap fee. Trustless VERIFYOUT covenant; pools are good-till-cancelled and discovered from a shared on-chain registry. Interoperable with the PandaPools MiniDapp (same pools).

apps.name: PandaDEX
apps.description: On-chain order-book DEX for MINIMA/mxUSDT with a built-in market maker. Every order is a V5 covenant coin holding your own funds — no custodian and no server can touch or erase them. Place limit orders, or sweep several resting orders in one transaction at the best available price. The MARKET MAKER publishes a ladder of up to 6 bids and 6 asks with a per-rung price and amount: peg it to the live MEXC mid and it re-prices itself as the market moves (keeping the amounts you set), or quote your own fixed prices and it never moves them. A price re-lock is ONE transaction and your funds never leave the book, and the ladder can be edited in place while it is live. Every rung shows its real on-chain state — mining, live, re-pricing or cancelling — and a whole ladder withdraws in a handful of batched transactions. Good-till-cancelled orders auto-renew. Shares its order book with the PandaDEX MiniDapp. EXPERIMENTAL and it moves real funds — test small.
